remediations.detail: Caller AbortSignal now reaches answer and deliverable providers plus accident and safety-reference retrieval; aborts bypass fallback and retry work. OpenAI and Anthropic receive request signals. The finding remains open because Vertex only stops caller wait and fallback chains while its SDK transport continues, and KMA, Work24, and KOSHA enrichment descendants do not yet all observe the caller signal.

Document export concurrency uses an atomic Upstash sorted-set lease shared by instances. Production fails closed when distributed concurrency is absent or unavailable; local development retains the existing instance guard.

REST, ranked RPC, and vector RPC JSON bodies remain inside the five-second request deadline and enforce a one MiB streamed byte limit. Caller abort, fallback behavior, and malformed JSON failure semantics are covered.
